name: dev.squally/mcp
title: Squally
description: Query Playwright test analytics from AI assistants: flaky tests, failures, CI time lost to retries.

environmentVariables.name: SQUALLY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Organization read key (sqly_ro_...), created in Squally under Organization > Read keys. Not the project ingest key.

environmentVariables.name: SQUALLY_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Squally API. Defaults to https://app.squally.dev.

environmentVariables.name: SQUALLY_USE_SYSTEM_CA
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to use only Node's bundled certificates instead of also trusting the operating system's certificate store.
